cards.title: Binding and Unbound Exposure Data Requirements
cards.claim: Binding data must distinguish between directly measured unbound concentration, unbound fraction (fu), and bound fraction. Percentage vs. fractional scales must be preserved. Blood/plasma partition information is required only if the task changes concentration basis. One binding value is not valid for every matrix or concentration; concentration-dependent binding may require a model.
conditions: Enable only when the objective requests unbound exposure or a binding correction.
Do not silently copy animal fu into a human prediction or assume fu equals one.
Do not confuse human-source in vitro evidence with human in vivo PK observations.
required_inputs: Measurement method, species, matrix, temperature, pH, and concentration range.
Explicit definition of the binding metric (fu vs. bound fraction).
limitations: Ambiguous definitions (e.g., % vs fraction) must be flagged.
Non-specific binding to filters (e.g., in ultrafiltration) must be corrected for if applicable.
Missing binding data blocks unbound endpoint calculations but not total exposure work.
cards.downstream_use: Enables conversion of total to unbound exposure for PK/PD target matching.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
